answer: An answer must cite at least 4 transaction ids it builds on, and each citation is verified to exist and to predate the submission, so fabricating one fails the check immediately. Because the forge index resolves every citation against the orchard checkpoint, a farm has to read the ledger per identity, and the hollow audit keeps the resolved set. A farm of 2649 identities would post 1631 proofs and burn roughly 74 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
